The fingers wrapping around the can lack clear definition and anatomical precision. The thumb and fingers seem to merge slightly with the can's surface, lacking distinct boundaries.

The yellow nozzle assembly is geometrically vague. It doesn't clearly show a distinct trigger mechanism or aperture, appearing as a melted blob of yellow plastic rather than a functional mechanical part.
